neighbours.label: the token '-induced' in 'X-induced' (a condition caused by X)
fire: Doctors say noise-induced hearing loss is often permanent.
She has exercise-induced asthma and uses an inhaler before running.
The study looked at alcohol-induced liver damage in mice.
Many patients report medication-induced weight gain.
The team measured laser-induced heating of the sample.
He was treated for a drug-induced rash.
Researchers described a virus-induced change in the cells.
Chronic stress-induced insomnia affects millions of adults.
quiet: Doctors say hearing loss from loud noise is often permanent.
She has mild asthma and uses an inhaler before running.
The study looked at liver damage in mice that drank alcohol.
Many patients report weight gain while on medication.
The team measured how the laser heated the sample.
He was treated for a rash after taking the drug.
Researchers described a change in the cells after infection.
Chronic insomnia caused by stress affects millions of adults.

notes: probe: drug-induced 0.91, stress-induced 0.20, Gold fever 0.73, heat-related 0.19, war-torn 0.17. Near misses keep the causal meaning without the '-induced' token.
